description: The dataset provides anonymised consumer heat-load profiles for a rural district-heating network, normalised to an annual sum of one kilowatt-hour per consumer. CSV columns identify generic consumer labels. The provider is Claudia Benesch, TU Wien. Coverage: Coverage is 18 consumers in Großschönau, Lower Austria, during 2024. Eleven profiles are daily; seven aggregate minute measurements to hourly sums. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The provider specifies Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike 4.0. Commercial reuse is restricted and share-alike conditions apply. Limitations: Normalisation removes absolute heat-demand magnitudes, and the two consumer groups have different time resolutions. Reuse needs external demand scaling. For simulation it supports demand-shape comparisons and scaled network-load assumptions. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
